entries.rtspcat: RTSP/RTP H.264 client, access units out as framed records

entries.chattr: Change file attributes on a Linux filesystem
entries.lsattr: List file attributes on a Linux filesystem
entries.mkswap: Set up a Linux swap area

entries.wipefs: Detect or wipe filesystem / swap signatures
entries.fincore: Count pages of a file resident in core (the page cache)
entries.fsfreeze: Suspend or resume access to a filesystem

entries.fstrim: Discard unused blocks on a mounted filesystem
entries.renice: Change the niceness of running processes (POSIX renice)
entries.taskset: Run or query commands with a CPU affinity mask
entries.chrt: Show or change process scheduling policy and priority
entries.uclampset: Show process utilization clamp values through sched_getattr(2)
entries.split: Split a file into pieces (POSIX split)
entries.join: Relational join on two sorted files (POSIX join)
entries.tac: Concatenate and print files in reverse (last record first)
entries.colrm: Remove byte-columns from each stdin line (util-linux colrm)
entries.hexdump: Byte-oriented hex dump (hexdump-compatible, focused on -C canonical)
entries.tput: Query a curated terminfo-compatible ANSI capability table
entries.strings: Print printable character sequences from files or stdin
entries.ar: Create, list, or extract simple ar archives. Writes are deterministic
entries.uudecode: Decode traditional uuencode and base64-uuencode streams
entries.ptybroker: Persistent local raw PTYs with bounded native I/O
